messages.subject: Aqualis divestment — potential purchasers
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Following up from the seller side — the former Halworth shareholders are keen to see the Aqualis line go to a good home, and we've had informal approaches from two trade buyers (a UK pump distributor and a European OEM looking to enter UK water). Happy to share what we know if it helps the CMA's purchaser-approval process. We have the divestment asset schedule from the executed undertakings; let us know if you want us to make introductions.

Best
Oliver

Oliver Jennings | Partner | Birchall Stone LLP
